scenes.heading: Dostoevsky's Dark Discovery
sentences: If you are suffering right now, Dostoevsky understood why.
Before Sigmund Freud ever studied the mind, Dostoevsky discovered the darkest psychological trap humans walk into.

scenes.heading: The Trap of Suffering
sentences: He wrote: 'Man is sometimes extraordinarily, passionately in love with suffering.'
Why? Because pain gives us an easy excuse.
It lets us blame the world instead of facing our own choices.

scenes.heading: Familiar Misery
sentences: Your mind prefers familiar misery over the terror of responsibility.
Pain feels like an achievement, but holding onto it keeps you trapped.

scenes.heading: Choosing Freedom
sentences: The moment you drop the story of your past... you become free.
Real strength isn't enduring pain—it's choosing to step out of it.
